subject: shinyio is not displaying words that contains accents

messages.author: 8f6e55336a3a1913
messages.subject: shinyio is not displaying words that contains accents
parts:
Hello guys! 

I am a Brazilian student and I am publishing the App in two languages: english and portuguese. However, when I publish the app and select portuguese, all the words that come with accents are not displayed. Ex.: Trees (english) Árvores (correct portuguese) , how it is displayed: rvores. 
The weird thing is that in R console it displays the word correctly but when I publish it all the letters with stress are not displayed. I tried to save the files with encode UTF 8 but did not have success.
Here's the app's link: https://iaslouriene.shinyapps.io/IndivTreeDetecLiDAR/

Does anyone have an idea of how to fix this? 

I'd really appreciate! 
Best, 

Iasmim
